log: Phase A done: 5 findings cards posted to /live/design/ tab "Tabs page" (ids zjjvacrt, oslevigb, p7uk6y1j, crzfow1z, kqg5bk2n). Findings: (1) Overview=tabs() home tab, no page wrapper/h1; Alpha/Beta are real nested Pages with their own h1 (Page.class.js:564). (2) explorer widget only draws via Jsonl.load's content.fallback(log_view) for a real page.jsonl page; Gamma was made by a bare `tab` line (Page.class.js add(), no jsonl) so never gets it. (3) "Files·N" chip + /files/ route are generic on every titled page (Page.class.js:590, :398) — Gamma gets the chip but not the explorer. (4) scroll bug root cause found: public/styles.css:299-300 `.pages:not(:has(>.page.active-page))...{overflow-y:hidden}` assumes the leaf is a direct child of .pages; a tabs page nests the leaf many levels down via .active-ancestor with no extra .pages region, so the one real scroll region gets hidden. Measured headless: scrollHeight 909 vs clientHeight 649. That file is outside my fence, so Phase B fixes it from core/Page/Page.css by giving the outer tabs-page its own overflow:auto scroll, tested working (scrollTop reaches max 260 = 909-649). (5) voice/tab content: recommended wiring `tab` line's `content` key through the fresh-`page.add` branch (Jsonl.js tab(), ~line126) so a folder-less tab can show text.
